$comment: Redundant copies of top-level functions sharing a name AND a byte-identical body across files, per package: a function in N files counts N-1. Regenerate with `bun run scripts/clone-census.ts --update` and review the diff. Ratchet: any increase fails CI. Only exact copies count — once a copy drifts it is two functions and only a human can say whether the difference was meant, which is why this gate stops the copy being MADE.
